reader.requirement: At 1985 an item without the SYNCHRONIZED clause is stored exactly where the record description places it, with no implicit FILLER or slack, so the programmer can synchronize data by organizing it (explicit FILLER, item order) and every group, REDEFINES overlay, table and file record is the contiguous sum of its described items.
reader.edition-search: grep of Edition|CobolVersion|DialectBehavior|Std in RecordLayout.cs, BitLayout.cs and ItemLength.cs: no hit; the layout is a pure function of the declared shape
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness measures five 4-byte records by LENGTH; offsets through a REDEFINES view, an explicit organizing FILLER, an 18-digit binary item, an OCCURS DEPENDING table and a file record are not exercised

probes.expected: ODO table of X + S9(4) COMP entries: 1 + 3 per occurrence, no padding

probes.printed: LR=0014 RX1=A RX3=CD RX5=E; PX1=A- PX3=C LP=0005
probes.expected: items at the described offsets (1+2+2+8+1); the programmer's FILLER places PB at offset 2
the largest 18-digit binary item and a negative value stored without disturbing the neighbours
a sequential file record laid out contiguously, read back at the same offsets

citations.check: OK  §1985:IV.4.3.7 GR2  (4.3.7 Item Alignment for Increased Object-Code Efficiency)  the text is in GR2

reader.notes: The rule is permissive: it lets the programmer align data by organizing it, which needs the compiler to add nothing implicit; sync1 prints the same at --std 2023. Probe class b has no refusal half (the rule forbids nothing) and class c has no edition-only form.

refuter.evidence: Probes (refute-1985-c01/src). ral1 at --std 85 (runs/ral1-002): a group of X, S9(4) COMP, X, USAGE INDEX, X, S9(9) COMP, X, S9(18) COMP, X with no SYNCHRONIZED has LG=27, the index item taking 8 and every X at its contiguous offset (B at 4, C at 13, D at 18, E at 27, read through a REDEFINES); a table of (X, S9(9) COMP) entries is 20 long with TA(2) at 6 and TA(3) at 11; the programmer's organizing FILLER places OB at offset 5 (LORG=08). ral2 at 85 and 2023 (ral2-001/-002): even a SYNCHRONIZED item draws no implicit FILLER from its non-synchronized neighbours (LS=05, B at 4, C at 5), and a relative-file record of the same mixed usages is 8 long and reads back at the same offsets (R=XY FB=-0005 FD1=+000000099); the same output at both editions. The rule only permits the programmer to synchronize by organizing the data; the compiler inserts nothing, which is what the rule needs. Reference to an index item in FUNCTION LENGTH is refused COBOL6979 (§1985:VI.5.14.3 SR5), correct and outside this rule. cite.py: OK §1985:IV.4.3.7 GR2; OK §1985:IV.4.3.7 (p1, the object program decides storage).
